deadline.value: Complete applications for a Fall start are due June 9 (year inferred), but internationals are encouraged to apply by April, and applying by mid-January keeps you in the entrance-scholarship competition.
deadline.quote: FALL: June 9th | International Students are encouraged to apply early for the semester in which they wish to study, i.e. August for Spring intake, December for Summer intake and April for Fall intake.

also.quote: you are strongly encouraged to submit an application for admission to the Department of Biological Sciences by mid-January

gre_subject.value: The biology pages checked do not mention the GRE.

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to support your application before you apply online.
supervisor.quote: Please do not submit an on-line application (Step 2) before a faculty member has agreed to support your appliction. | confirmation of supervisor is required for all programs except MET

funding.value: PhD students get guaranteed minimum funding of about CAD 34,800 a year for 12 terms, subject to a 3.5 CGPA and satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students in the program will be funded for a minimum of 12 terms. | Students in the PhD program will receive guaranteed minimum funding in the amount of $34,800

entry_route.value: Entry is possible from a bachelor's (CGPA 3.5 plus evidence of research ability) or from an MSc, in both cases with a committed supervisor.
entry_route.quote: Entry to the PhD program in Biological Sciences requires either: | completion of a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university with a minimun cgpa of 3.5 | completion of an MSc or equivalent from a recognized university

notes: Start in any term (January, May or September).
